name: The Heartlands
description: The Heartlands is a region of rolling hills, with wide slow rivers and expansive forests. There are many villages about a day's journey apart, and where roads meet or rivers are crossed there are larger towns. The inhabitants are often halflings, humans, or other gregarious peace-loving folk.

adventures.name: Monster Attack
adventures.description: There is a Monster. The Monster attacked a Place inhabited by people. The people got some heroes to go to the Lair where the Monster lives to defeat it. When the heroes defeated the Monster they found some Treasure.
